title: Sabarimala Gold Theft: Kerala High Court Directs SIT To Complete Probe After Receipt Of Scientific Report From National Metallurgical Lab
description: The Kerala High Court on Monday (July 20) noted that the final scientific report from the CSIR National Metallurgical Laboratory, Jamshedpur, Jharkhand has been received by the Special Investigation Team (SIT) probing the Sabarimala Gold Theft case. The case refers to the alleged misappropriation of gold from the gold-cladded Dwarapalaka idols and door frames of the Sabarimala temple.
